title: selliguea wardii
intro: Selliguea wardii, commonly known as Polypodium wardii or Chinese polypody, is a type of fern plant native to the mountainous regions of China and Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, sore throats, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea wardii include anti-tumor and anti-viral activities, as well as its ability to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and have been the subject of scientific research for their potential health benefits.
